summary: Harbor cam dashboard MVP for Ashtabula Harbor. Research identified the Ashtabula County Port Authority as the correct target entity (NOT 'Ashtabula Maritime Partnership' which doesn't exist). The harbor has a robust maritime ecosystem with 11 marinas, multiple yacht clubs, fishing charters, and tourism organizations. A harbor cam dashboard would serve boaters, tourists, and maritime businesses by providing real-time visibility of harbor conditions, lift bridge status, and weather.

leads.name: Ashtabula Yacht Club
leads.fit_rationale: Premier yacht club with 200+ members and 140 docks located directly on the Ashtabula River at historic Bridge Street. Already integrated into the harbor ecosystem and would benefit from harbor cam visibility for member safety and dock scheduling. High engagement boating community that values real-time harbor conditions.
leads.source: Multiple sources including aycohio.com, Waterway Guide, Yelp, Marinalife

leads.name: Ashtabula County Port Authority
leads.fit_rationale: Official economic development entity created in 1988 by county commissioners. Manages harbor infrastructure, industrial parks, and port facilities. Primary stakeholder for any harbor-wide technology initiative. Would provide legitimacy and potential funding/partnership for harbor cam deployment.
leads.source: ashtabulacounty.us, Ohio Council of Port Authorities

leads.name: Redbrook Boat Club
leads.fit_rationale: Already operates a LakeVision camera (Camera Eleven) hosted at lakevision.com - demonstrates existing investment in harbor visibility technology. Located on Lake Erie between Cleveland and Erie, PA. Has established relationships with other yacht clubs. Ideal early adopter since they understand the value proposition.

leads.name: Historic Ashtabula Harbor / Lift Bridge Community Association
leads.fit_rationale: Promotes Bridge Street district - voted 'America's Main Street Winner'. Focuses on tourism, historic preservation, and harbor events. Harbor cam would be a major tourism asset, allowing visitors to check conditions before visiting. Strong marketing reach and community engagement.

leads.name: Harbor Yacht Club & Marina
leads.fit_rationale: Private marina with direct Lake Erie access. Located at 1833 Giannell Ave in Ashtabula. Offers seasonal dock openings and caters to fishing and boating enthusiasts near Geneva On The Lake. Would benefit from harbor condition visibility for member communications and safety alerts.

branding_quality_assessment.current_state: The MVP shows 'Ashtabula Maritime Partnership' which research confirms does NOT exist. The correct target entity is the Ashtabula County Port Authority (verified government entity with EIN, established 1988).
branding_quality_assessment.why_correction_matters: Promoting a non-existent entity ('Ashtabula Maritime Partnership') would damage credibility and potentially violate truth-in-advertising. The Port Authority is a real government entity that manages harbor infrastructure and economic development.

site_improvements.fix: Replace 'Ashtabula Maritime Partnership' with 'Ashtabula County Port Authority' throughout the site
site_improvements.impact: High - without this fix, the MVP is promoting a fictional organization

site_improvements.fix: Add Port Authority contact: 91 N Chestnut St, Jefferson OH 44047, (440) 576-6069

site_improvements.issue: No integration with existing harbor cams
site_improvements.fix: Partner with Redbrook Boat Club's existing LakeVision camera or integrate their feed
Add real-time lift bridge opening schedule/status - critical for boaters
site_improvements.impact: High for boaters - the lift bridge opens on the half-hour per Waterway Guide

aesthetics_and_layout_notes: The current MVP has a clean, functional dashboard layout suitable for a harbor cam interface. The dark theme works well for camera feeds. However, the branding needs complete replacement. Consider adding: 1) Weather widget integration, 2) Live lift bridge countdown timer, 3) Partner marina logos (Ashtabula Yacht Club, Harbor Yacht Club, etc.), 4) Quick links to member login for partner organizations.

whitelabel_potential.reasoning: The harbor cam dashboard architecture is highly reusable for other Lake Erie ports (Cleveland, Erie PA, Sandusky, etc.). The widget-based layout makes it easy to swap branding, camera feeds, and partner organizations. Could be white-labeled as 'Great Lakes HarborCam' or similar regional product.
whitelabel_potential.estimated_white_label_value: Significant - Great Lakes region has 11 major ports that could use similar dashboard

action_next: URGENT: Before any marketing or outreach, correct the target entity name from 'Ashtabula Maritime Partnership' to 'Ashtabula County Port Authority'. Then initiate contact with the Port Authority Director to discuss partnership for harbor visibility initiative. Secondary contacts: Ashtabula Yacht Club Commodore and Redbrook Boat Club officers (who already understand harbor cam value).
